name: GOODWILL INDUSTRIES OF SOUTH FLORIDA INC
naics_description: CUT AND SEW APPAREL MANUFACTURING (EXCEPT CONTRACTORS)
brief_text:
Four detectors flagged this entity. Benford's law analysis of leading digits in award amounts showed a modest deviation from expected frequency distribution, though not statistically significant at conventional thresholds. Modification growth on a single parent contract exhibited extreme acceleration, with dollar value expanding at a rate 65 times faster than the median peer in the same industry classification. An Isolation Forest multivariate analysis identified the entity as a moderate statistical outlier based on its feature profile. Sole-source award concentration was substantially elevated, with 92 percent of contracts awarded without competition compared to a peer median of zero percent.

The worst-performing contract, W91CRB21D0028, showed a modification growth ratio of 1194.2 against a NAICS average of 18.5, yielding a z-score of 13.96. The entity holds 119 lifetime awards totaling 189.1 million dollars, all from the Department of Defense. Of those 119 awards, 110 were sole-source, placing it 2.37 standard deviations above peers in sole-source concentration. The Isolation Forest raw anomaly score was negative 0.624, with a contamination parameter of 0.05.

These statistical signals warrant scrutiny but do not constitute proof of misconduct. Goodwill Industries operates in apparel manufacturing under a federal employment program for disabled workers, a context that may legitimately explain both concentrated DoD relationships and high sole-source award rates due to set-aside authority. The peer group for NAICS 315210 contains only 29 entities, limiting statistical power. Benford's test was not significant, and modification growth anomalies can reflect legitimate scope expansion on long-term contracts rather than fraud.
